players.product: Lithography equipment for advanced packaging and package substrates: UX-5 steppers, direct imaging (DI) lithography equipment and DLT maskless lithography systems

quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (April 2025 - March 2026): net sales JPY 179,211 million (up 0.9%), operating profit JPY 11,959 million (up 35.5%), ordinary profit JPY 13,346 million (up 7.2%), net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 7,995 million (up 17.6%). Production at selling prices JPY 137,616 million (104.8% of the prior year); the company produces to forecast, so no order figures are disclosed
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 179,211 million (+0.9%); operating profit JPY 11,959 million (+35.5%)

quarterly_data.signal: Industrial Process segment, fiscal year ended March 2026: sales JPY 77,142 million (down 2.3%), segment profit JPY 6,486 million (down 32.6%); production JPY 62,614 million (105.6% of the prior year). Management states direct imaging (DI) lithography sales rose on growing generative-AI server demand, while projection lithography (stepper) sales fell: despite rising demand for generative-AI semiconductors, investment restraint continued because of weak conventional data center demand and past over-investment. Profit fell on lower sales, expanded upfront investment in lithography including digital lithography (DLT) systems, and temporary valuation losses on slow-moving assets from the delayed recovery in lithography demand. Exposure lamp sales rose (installed tools running steadily, supported by generative-AI semiconductor demand); optical-equipment lamp sales rose for flat panel displays and thermal processing; EUV light source maintenance revenue for EUV lithography mask inspection fell on cost-reduction-driven price cuts and lower utilization
quarterly_data.figure: Industrial Process sales JPY 77,142 million (-2.3%); segment profit JPY 6,486 million (-32.6%)

quarterly_data.signal: Other segments, fiscal year ended March 2026: Visual Imaging sales JPY 83,879 million (up 3.7%) and segment profit JPY 4,667 million (up 539.7%), with xenon cinema projector lamp sales down on the spread of laser projectors and high-end projector sales up; Life Science sales JPY 6,255 million (up 2.4%), segment profit JPY 140 million; Photonics Solution sales JPY 10,585 million (up 2.7%), segment profit JPY 564 million, with device and module sales for semiconductor and industrial uses firm
quarterly_data.figure: Visual Imaging JPY 83,879 million; Life Science JPY 6,255 million; Photonics Solution JPY 10,585 million

quarterly_data.signal: Management's review of year two of the Revive Vision 2030 strategy: the launch and recovery of the semiconductor advanced packaging market were delayed versus plan, but upfront investment was made as planned. DLT systems recorded their first sales in fiscal 2025 (year ended March 2026), with the contribution to results delayed from the original plan; the company expects DLT sales to expand gradually from fiscal 2026 (year ending March 2027). Stepper lithography recovery is lagging because of past over-investment, but business negotiations are increasing. The company states the full ramp-up and recovery of the advanced packaging business has been delayed to fiscal 2027 (company numbering, the year after the fiscal 2026 that ends March 2027) or later, but inquiries are surging, and it aims to secure orders and production capacity
quarterly_data.figure: DLT first sales in fiscal 2025 (year ended March 2026); gradual DLT sales growth expected from fiscal 2026 (year ending March 2027)

quarterly_data.signal: Strategy Revive Vision 2030 (announced May 2024; company fiscal-year numbering, fiscal 2026 = year ending March 2027; Phase I fiscal 2024-2026, Phase II fiscal 2027-2030): growth and development investment is concentrated on the Industrial Process business, with lithography equipment for semiconductor advanced packaging as the growth driver; the company aims to become the leading company in that market through a full lithography lineup, adding digital lithography equipment through the business alliance with Applied Materials announced in December 2023 to expand share toward 2030. Targets: ROE of 8% or more in fiscal 2026 and 12% or more in fiscal 2030
quarterly_data.figure: ROE target 8% or more (fiscal 2026), 12% or more (fiscal 2030)

quarterly_data.signal: The company decided to wind down part of its EUV business, whose profitability had declined: the EUV light sources in operation are expected to end operation during fiscal 2026 (year ending March 2027), and R&D will continue focused on new uses, mainly semiconductor inspection. Business transfers and fixed-cost cuts delivered JPY 6.7 billion of benefit in fiscal 2025 (year ended March 2026) versus a JPY 5.7 billion plan; the company expects JPY 8.0 billion of fixed-cost reduction in total including fiscal 2026 (year ending March 2027)
quarterly_data.figure: Fixed-cost reduction JPY 6.7 billion (plan JPY 5.7 billion); JPY 8.0 billion total expected

quarterly_data.signal: The acquisition of the ams-OSRAM group's lamp business (shares of a new ams-OSRAM AG subsidiary running the industrial and entertainment lamp business, plus the related assets) was completed on March 2, 2026; the company states it will accelerate consolidation of the light-source industry and pursue synergies in procurement, production and technology to strengthen the earnings base of its existing business

R&D, fiscal year ended March 2026: group R&D expenses JPY 13,547 million, of which Industrial Process JPY 7,635 million. The company completed development of a projection lithography tool for glass substrates and launched the first unit in 2024, and is now focused on a higher-quality next-generation lithography tool for leading-edge IC package substrates. Subsidiary Adtec Engineering is preparing the market launch of the new DI lithography tool IP-NX7000 for ultra-fine pattern drawing on advanced package substrates (FCBGA, FC-CSP, 2.5D/3D packages, chiplets, FOPLP), where demand for generative-AI GPU and HBM mounting is driving finer wiring, more layers, larger areas and higher overlay accuracy; an i-line compatible model is also in development
quarterly_data.figure: R&D JPY 13,547 million; Industrial Process R&D JPY 7,635 million

quarterly_data.signal: Capex, fiscal year ended March 2026: JPY 22,359 million (150.6% of the prior year), of which Industrial Process JPY 10,988 million (134.1%), centered on the lithography equipment business for semiconductors where demand is rising. Planned new facilities: production equipment at the Gotemba site (JPY 2,527 million) and the Harima site (JPY 1,524 million) for Industrial Process, both April 2026 to March 2027; plus renovation of Industrial Process production equipment at Harima (JPY 419 million) and Gotemba (JPY 231 million) over the same period
quarterly_data.figure: Capex JPY 22,359 million; Gotemba JPY 2,527 million and Harima JPY 1,524 million planned (April 2026 - March 2027)

quarterly_data.signal: No external customer accounted for 10% or more of consolidated net sales in the fiscal year ended March 2026, so no major customer is disclosed. Sales by customer location: Japan JPY 36,533 million, United States JPY 52,589 million, China JPY 31,311 million, other Asia JPY 36,910 million, Europe JPY 19,438 million (total JPY 179,211 million)
